001: What do you like to do in your free time?
I love playing the guitar and I also like cooking.
That's cool! How long have you been playing the guitar?
It's been about three years, but I'm still learning.
And cooking, what do you usually make?
I like making pasta and trying out new recipes.
002: Yes, I play soccer with some friends every Saturday.
Really? Where do you guys play?
At a field near my house, late in the afternoon.
That's great! Can I come watch one of these days?
Of course! We'd love to have you there.
003: I love it! Lately I've been reading a lot of Brazilian novels.
That's cool! What book are you reading right now?
I'm reading one by Machado de Assis, really engaging.
I want to get back into reading more too.
If you want, I can lend you some of my favorites.
004: Wow, that's interesting! Do you have a good camera?
I just use my phone, but I want to buy a better camera.
Where do you usually take pictures?
At the city parks, mostly on Sundays.
005: Do you like watching TV shows?
Yes, I do, especially thrillers and science fiction.
Do you have a good recommendation for me?
There's a new show that I loved, full of mystery.
It's called "O Caso Evandro," it's really good.
006: What do you do to relax after work?
I like taking care of my plants and listening to music.
That's nice! How many plants do you have at home?
I've lost count, I think more than twenty.
Yeah, it's become my favorite pastime, it calms me down a lot.
007: Have you tried learning something new lately?
Yes, I started taking a pottery class.
That's awesome! How did you get that idea?
A friend invited me and I ended up falling in love with it.
They're still pretty simple, but I'm getting better every day.
008: Do you like cooking or do you prefer ordering food?
I love cooking, especially on the weekends.
What's your favorite dish to make?
I like making feijoada, but it takes a while.
It is! One day you have to try it.
009: Do you have any hobby you like doing alone?
I like walking in the park while listening to podcasts.
That's cool! What kind of podcasts do you usually listen to?
I like some about history and also about science.
It is, I learn a lot while I exercise.
010: Do you like playing video games?
I do, but I only play every once in a while.
I like adventure games with a good story.
Oh, those are really fun too!
